item.title: Compare Murph with 100+ health products
item.summary: A new comparison library explains when Murph replaces, complements, or differs from the health products people already use.
item.details: Each guide leads with a practical relationship, then shows fit, tradeoffs, FAQs, current official-source links, and a verification date. The guides are non-affiliate desk research, not hands-on reviews or medical rankings.
